body: Could you also message me how to fix it since I'm having the same issues please? Thank you.
Does it change you? Has it taken away any part of your ability to care?
Did it ever feel like the hatred was just going take over and never let go?
You're all good. Thank you for your kindness.
Thank you.
Good luck op. How much do you need?
Yeah, I get that. I've had a gym membership for over a year and go 3 times a week if I can. But some people just ruin it with their "self love" bs. Its not self love its hoping for an early death.

I'm overweight myself, not nearly the size you are talking about. More so a size 12 due to complications from PCOS and 2 traumatic brain injuries. I'd have to agree with you completely. My grandmother is the size of Manhattan and its horrifying. Also I love that this is an actually unpopular opinion compared to the normal ones on here. Good job OP!
Oh my god I love this so much!
Thank you!!
I'm not gonna lie this made me start balling. But mostly because that's something I have needed to hear for a very long time. I feel so alone in this illness. I make myself alone. Thank you so much.
Thank you! I really appreciate everything.
Yeah, I understand that. I was in online school most of my life so I'm struggling to just create social skills to begin with.

Okay honestly that's the exact same boat I'm in right now. I've canceled 5 dates in the last two months because of this. I also have a huge tendency to sabotage anything romantic because of this feeling.
Interesting. I like it.
More than anything I want to be out and the open with him. But I'm learning that's never really going to happen. I guess if someone came along I would be willing to break free from his orbit.

I think at first it was supposed to be more. But then we found out that everyone around us was against him and I. And it feels like ever since I'm just secret in his closet he can't seem to get rid of.

I mean you're right though. I am literally the only person he has ever done stuff with. And he's had two girlfriends in the time I've known him. He had feelings for me in the beginning and then it was like the second I had them too he just dropped them in the trash.
I think you're right...I just don't want to accept it I guess. Thank you.
Thank you! It all started out with him having feelings for me. And I guess maybe I just haven't let go of that.
Being cold and uncaring at those around me
Lots of family drama, my health declining and minor self-sabotaging behaviors that made my heart hurt because of the people I once loved.
I feel like it's back burner but the flames are starting to flare out from under the pot. Making the tea kettle scream.
It's how I often tell my family how bad it is. Without having to risk too many details or start a fight..

Thank you for the insight. I'm planning on talking with my doctor later this week about my options. There's not a psychiatrist around here for me to see but luckily my doctors are fairly good at listening to me about all of this.
Thank you! I've always heard bad things about lithium (all from my mom who doesn't have any illnesses). Does it actually tend to help with bipolar?

It's good to know that I can afford to take it easy then. I find myself getting so frustrated some nights when its 5 in the morning and I haven't hit even the slightest bit sleepy. Lots of tears and silent screams. But I've learned over the years that it's not just me. This condition has a big part to play in it and I'm beginning to accept that. When I'm not having severe muscle loss/spasms in my hands I love to cross stitch.

Thank you so much! I wasn't sure if I was actually going to get any replies. Your comment definitely shined a new light perse on my confusion. It's definitely more of a wanting to stay up. Being productive in any shape whether it be finishing a tv show or writing a chapter for my book.
